The '''MC95D Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] that was present in [[the galaxy]] by the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. In [[35 ABY]], many MC95D [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]s were present on [[Exegol]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] between the Resistance and the [[Sith Eternal]].

==Description==
[[File:MC95D-Star-Cruiser.png|thumb|left|250px|An MC95D Star Cruiser]]
The MC95D [[Star Cruiser]] was a [[Star Cruiser]] of [[Mon Calamari]] design. The MC95D [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]<ref name="Ship ST" /> was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] which gave it the capability of entering [[hyperspace]] at [[lightspeed]],<ref name="Episode IX" /> and was equipped with at least eight [[sublight engine]]s. Two dual [[engine]]s were located on the port and starboard aft section, while there were four larger engine units at the rear in a square formation.<ref name="ILM" /> The MC95D Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> could be disabled when struck by powerful [[Force lightning]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

Characteristically of other Mon Calamari ship designs,<ref name="A Final Alliance">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Target Exclusive)|featurette=A Final Alliance}}</ref> the MC95D Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> had a bulbous [[hull]] with differing modules,<ref name="Episode IX" /> and uniquely had a large tower at the aft mid-section of the vessel. Behind the large tower and its module, there was another smaller command tower. The ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the forward section near the bow of the vessel. Additionally, the MC95D had two large wings on the port and starboard at the mid-section of the ship, with a large module near the tips of each wing. The MC95D also possessed two smaller wings at the bow of the ship. It was equipped with [[laser cannon]]s and two [[hangar]]s on its hull on both sides, also near the bow.<ref name="ILM" />

==Role==
As a [[capital ship]], the MC95D Star Cruiser had the ability to participate in [[Space warfare|naval warfare]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
MC95D Star Cruisers<ref name="Ship ST" /> were in service by the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> the [[First Order]], a military junta that was the spiritual successor of the Old [[Galactic Empire]], and the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary private group with foundations to the dissolved [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and the destroyed [[New Republic]].<ref name="BFA">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> the Alliance and Republic heroes [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Chewbacca]] were sent on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to rally the citizens of [[the galaxy]] to aid the Resistance, which traveled to the ancient [[Sith]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Exegol]] in an attempt to finally destroy the resurgent [[Sith Eternal]], which allied itself with the First Order, and save the [[galaxy]] from their rule.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:GalaxyFleet.png|thumb|right|290px|The 14,000 strong citizens' fleet contained many MC95D Star Cruisers.]]
As the Resistance neared defeat and suffered heavy losses during the battle, an enormous 14,000 ship strong [[Citizens' Fleet]] from across the galaxy arrived at Exegol and participated in the climactic [[Battle of Exegol]], including many MC95D Star Cruisers. Reinforced, the combined allied force attacked the [[Final Order]], a massive fleet of planet-[[Death|killing]] [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that numbered above 1,000 ships. As the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and [[Ben Solo]] fought against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] on the surface at the [[Sith Citadel]], [[Darth]] Sidious gained [[The Force|Force power]] from the [[Force dyad]] between Rey and Solo, and unleashed a torrent of powerful Force lightning at the galactic fleet, disabling many vessels. After Rey regained her energy and continued the fight, the lightning dissipated and the fleet regained its power, allowing them to continue fighting. Darth Sidious was then eventually disintegrated by his own power after Rey deflected his lightning, finally killing him. The remaining [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the Sith Eternal on Exegol were destroyed, and an [[uprising against the First Order]] began throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TRXCaseStudyv2-19.jpg|thumb|right|The MC95D Star Cruiser was one of the many new ship models created by ILM for ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker''.]]
The MC95D Star Cruiser first appeared in the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] and the [[sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> It was first identified in an installment of ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' on [[StarWarsKids.com]] in [[2020]].<ref name="Ship ST" />
